build: Windows x64, LLVM 23 clang-cl, Release, assertions enabled, LTO/PGO disabled

loopback_configuration.note: File gates and inspector exist only in generated copied translation units. The stalled case intentionally uses the supported minimum absolute deadline; all other cases use default deadlines.

coverage_notes: Native snapshots compare service drafts, partially prepared graphs, row Work, speculative workers and retained generations in Legacy and Hyperpath modes.
Native asymmetric worker tests cover 0/8, 8/0, 4/1, delayed and failing workers; publication fields, serialized state and transport are compared.
Real loopback tests cover preparation before enabling, services, graph, tables, client first, host first, multiple joins, disconnect, ordinary join, and a stalled client.
Native server tests simulate Map/DoneMap/PreActive and disconnect states while exercising the real preparation and READY handlers.
limits: Loopback tests use a small vanilla fixture on Windows; WAN throughput and large real-map performance were not benchmarked.
The stopped-client deadline is exercised at 60 seconds; the default 900-second boundary is covered with a synthetic clock in native tests.

implementation.snapshot_safety: Existing Save/Load/FinishLoad/StepLoad reconstruct committed service inputs, retained generations and deterministic row Work. Suspended service drafts, graph coroutine scratch and speculative worker results are recomputed locally; saving never restarts or cancels the host builder.
implementation.barrier: Snapshot recipients register frame F before saving. Map and DoneMap hold the barrier; preparation is announced before any frame permission after MAP_OK. Simulation resumes only after the host and all remaining participants report ready for F.
implementation.first_sync: The existing random seed and state checksum checks also validate an already completed frame before advancing. Only a validated first sync emits the initial simulation ACK and closes the join window; new-company registration retains its completion hook.
implementation.deadlines: Queue, download, replay and preparation count toward the authorization-to-join deadline without host-preparation exemptions. Download has a wall-clock deadline even while frames are paused; replay progress remains bounded, monotonic and rate limited. Existing barrier lag exemptions do not acknowledge unrun frames.
